Maria Julia Margarita Josefa Emirena Justiniana LERENA LENGUAS
column6: Born and baptised at ROSARIO, not Montevideo. Her fifth name, JUSTINIANA, is her paternal grandmother's - which is how we know the Geneanet parentage and the act describe one family.
Father Luis, mother Julia, place not stated. Recorded in this archive FOUR DAYS BEFORE the Rosario act was read, and unremarkable at the time. It is the same couple.
